article.story: Michigan State (2-2) at Wisconsin (3-1), Oct. 3 at 12:30 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: Wisconsin by 10. Against the spread: Wisconsin 2-2, Michigan State 2-1-1. How to watch: BTN Key stats Wisconsin Offense Overall: 381 yards per game (81st in FBS) Passing: 246.8 yards per game (56th) Rushing: 134.3 yards per game (104th) Scoring: 31.8 points per game (66th) Wisconsin Defense Overall: 275.3 yards per game (28th in FBS) Passing: 163.8 yards per game (22nd) Rushing: 111.5 yards per game (39th) Scoring: 20 points per game (45th) Michigan State Offense Overall: 323.3 yards per game (122nd in FBS) Passing: 200.5 yards per game (104th) Rushing: 122.8 yards per game (114th) Scoring: 22 points per game (110th) Michigan State Defense Overall: 314 yards per game (45th in FBS) Passing: 190 yards per game (48th) Rushing: 124 yards per game (62nd) Scoring: 21.3 points per game (54th) Michigan State ranks 120th in the FBS with a -4 turnover margin. Michigan State is 19th in the FBS averaging 41.3 penalty yards per game. Wisconsin ranks 114th in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 92.3% of trips. Michigan State's red zone offense ranks 76th, scoring in 85.7% of red zone trips. Wisconsin ranks 105th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 28:34, compared to Michigan State's 40th-ranked average of 31:49. Team leaders Wisconsin Passing: Colton Joseph, 987 yards, 7 TDs, 5 INTs, 58.5 completion percentage Rushing: Abu Sama III, 190 yards on 28 carries, 1 TD Receiving: Tyrell Henry, 307 yards on 24 catches, 1 TD Michigan State Passing: Alessio Milivojevic, 748 yards, 3 TDs, 3 INTs, 67.0 completion percentage Rushing: Cam Edwards, 304 yards on 64 carries, 3 TDs Receiving: Rodney Bullard Jr., 193 yards on 14 catches, 1 TD Last game Wisconsin beat Penn State 24-20 on Sept. 26. Joseph passed for 235 yards on 18-of-38 attempts (47.4%) with two touchdowns and three interceptions. He also carried the ball 13 times for 39 yards and one rushing touchdown. Darrion Dupree had 52 rushing yards on eight carries, adding four receptions for 44 yards. Jacob Harris had five receptions for 105 yards and one touchdown. Michigan State fell to Nebraska 31-13 on Sept. 26. Milivojevic led Michigan State with 208 yards on 18-of-26 passing (69.2%) for no touchdowns and one interception. Jaziun Patterson carried the ball 16 times for 54 yards and scored one touchdown, adding one reception for three yards. Chrishon McCray had four receptions for 47 yards. Next game Wisconsin plays at No. 23 UCLA on Oct. 17. Michigan State hosts Illinois on Oct. 10.
